scope: 35 study/standard entries, not 35 independent experimental papers

studies.title: LINC: A Neurosymbolic Approach for Logical Reasoning by Combining Language Models with First-Order Logic Provers
studies.representation: Prover9 FOL; premises and conclusion
studies.method: Few-shot NL→FOL, prover labels, ten-sample majority vote.
studies.verification_guarantee: Prover derivation is relative to generated formulas.
not_guaranteed: Source fidelity
Implicit typing and predicate decomposition
Translation error independence across samples

evaluation.caveat: FOLIO removes 22 problematic examples from the historical 204; not directly comparable to other FOLIO versions.
evaluation.aggregation: Figure 3: mean accuracy from bootstrapped 10-way majority votes for LINC and comparators, including CoT.

studies.transfer_to_repo: Useful solver baseline and explicit unknown; macro predicates and missing types resemble component loss in case 522.

studies.title: Logic-LM: Empowering Large Language Models with Symbolic Solvers for Faithful Logical Reasoning
studies.representation: Task-specific logic programming, FOL, CSP, SMT
studies.method: Sentence/formula alignment, solver execution, error-message self-refinement, CoT fallback.
studies.verification_guarantee: Execution and solver checks conditional on representation.
not_guaranteed: Executable formulas can invert direction or scope
Refinement is not guaranteed semantically monotone

evaluation.endpoint: Final answer accuracy; execution rate and conditional execution accuracy

studies.transfer_to_repo: CNF compilation can follow semantic parsing; syntax repair alone does not fix case 74 polarity or case 119 false hard confirmation.

studies.title: FOLIO: Natural Language Reasoning with First-Order Logic
studies.primary_type: EMNLP peer-reviewed dataset paper; initial arXiv 2022
studies.representation: Human-authored parallel NL/FOL stories and conclusions
studies.method: Expert annotation and formal label verification; distinct translation and inference tasks.
studies.verification_guarantee: Checks formal labels against supplied reference formulas.
not_guaranteed: Conclusion accuracy is not full translation equivalence
Reference data can require corrections

evaluation.endpoint: Whole-story syntax and conclusion accuracy, not slot-level source fidelity

studies.transfer_to_repo: Reference-source inventory and independently annotated formulas are needed; gold rank cannot substitute for extraction fidelity.
studies.code_status: Data repository inspected; version drift noted

studies.title: Harnessing the Power of Large Language Models for Natural Language to First-Order Logic Translation
studies.representation: CFG-parsed FOL; MALLS parallel NL/FOL
studies.method: LLM-generated data with filtering and human sample review; LoRA translation/correction and reward-based correction.
studies.verification_guarantee: Parser checks syntax; released LE score checks literal Boolean agreement under soft matching.
not_guaranteed: LE is not quantified FOL equivalence
Human review of a sample does not certify all synthetic pairs
Soft symbol matching may hide wrong predicates

evaluation.endpoint: BLEU and LE; human data-quality sample
evaluation.metric_audit: Static reading: metrics.py uses soft_binding=True, greedy_match=True; VecRuleEvaluator.from_nltk_tree at S visits only root[-1], dropping quantifier prefix from Boolean evaluation. No dynamic execution claimed.

studies.transfer_to_repo: Do not reward the current quantifier/scope failures with LE; benchmark typed reference formulas instead.
studies.code_status: README and evaluator source inspected; not executed

studies.title: Divide and Translate: Compositional First-Order Logic Translation and Verification for Complex Logical Reasoning
studies.representation: Many-sorted FOL with logical dependency structures
studies.method: LLM first prepares an estimated theory and target NL sentence set from the whole problem; then decomposes into units, couplers and dependents; progressive translation; equivalence clusters; solver counter-interpretations judged against prepared NL by an LLM.
studies.verification_guarantee: Solver checks formula equivalence and produces distinguishing interpretations.
not_guaranteed: NL judgment of a countermodel remains learned
Correct formula may not be in sampled candidates
Initial theory/signature may be wrong
Preprocessing fidelity and coverage: checking the prepared NL targets cannot restore an original qualifier lost in preprocessing.

evaluation.endpoint: Final answer accuracy, executability, conditional accuracy; annotated AR-LSAT formula analysis

studies.transfer_to_repo: Directly relevant to nested connective/quantifier composition and discriminating group counterexamples; preserve source coverage outside the solver.

studies.title: LOGIC-LM++: Multi-Step Refinement for Symbolic Formulations
studies.representation: Logic-LM symbolic representations
studies.method: Restore source problem/question to refinement; pairwise LLM semantic comparison and backtracking.
studies.verification_guarantee: Existing solver checks remain; semantic edit acceptance is model-based.
not_guaranteed: Backtracking cannot certify source equivalence
Very wrong initial formulas and weaker semantic judges remain difficult
studies.transfer_to_repo: Source-aware reversible repairs can be tested on polarity and overstatement; an accepted edit is still not a clinical certificate.
studies.code_status: No official repository located in reviewed paper or targeted author/project searches; not proof that none exists

studies.title: Autoformalizing Natural Language to First-Order Logic: A Case Study in Logical Fallacy Detection
studies.primary_type: Findings IJCNLP-AACL peer-reviewed paper; earlier arXiv 2024
studies.representation: FOL compiled to CVC4 SMT
studies.method: Entities, predicates, claims and conclusion; NLI-inferred background implications; validity checking and countermodel explanation.
studies.verification_guarantee: SMT reasoning relative to compiled theory.
not_guaranteed: Inferred background implications are not explicit source rules
Fallacy classification is not exact formalization

evaluation.caveat: Table 2 uses datasets augmented with non-fallacious negative arguments derived from SNLI entailments; the direct comparator is few-shot end-to-end classification, not the unaugmented original LOGIC task.

studies.transfer_to_repo: Keep inferred bridge assumptions separate from guideline provenance; countermodel explanations can expose unsupported diagnostic implications.
source_locations: Method pipeline and SMT construction; experimental setup/Table 2

studies.title: FoVer: First-Order Logic Verification for Natural Language Reasoning
studies.representation: Python functions using a custom Z3 FOL wrapper
studies.method: Coarse-to-fine annotated reasoning, predicate/type definitions, delayed quantifier declaration, optional separate common-knowledge statements. Algorithm 1 removes definitions in an unsatisfiable core before verifying the retained theory; this changes the theory.
studies.verification_guarantee: Z3 checks conclusions relative to the retained compiled theory, after any removal of conflicting auxiliary definitions.
not_guaranteed: Correct Python is not correct NL grounding
Optional background knowledge can introduce unsupported premises
Quantifier declaration conventions do not prove semantic scope
Unsat-core removal does not certify fidelity of the removed or retained definitions to the original text, or prove a maximum-faithfulness repair.

evaluation.caveat: Table 2 distinguishes single queried conclusion from all questions in a sample; paper does not establish a same-cached-formulas, scoring-only contrast, and execution rates differ. Relaxed scoring accepts True/False when the original label is Unknown. These are not source-fidelity metrics.
evaluation.FOLIO_prompt_condition: Table 3 specific prompt places entities in one Entity sort; universal prompt may infer different sorts.

studies.transfer_to_repo: Typed program representation and separate background channel are useful; source-only and augmented conditions need separate reporting.
source_locations: §3.3 Algorithm 1: definition removal; §5.1/Table 2: strict versus relaxed; §5.2/Table 3: universal versus specific Entity-sort prompt

studies.title: Advancing Natural Language Formalization to First Order Logic with Fine-tuned LLMs
studies.representation: Grammar-parsed FOL, Z3 reference equivalence
studies.method: Fine-tune on MALLS/Willow; compare free, supplied/noisy predicates and two-stage predicate prediction; optional predicate-name matching.
studies.verification_guarantee: Proved unsatisfiability of negated biconditional establishes equivalence under encoded reference/signature.
not_guaranteed: Timeout is not inequivalence
Reference equivalence assumes correct reference and symbol grounding
Oracle predicate lists do not measure end-to-end extraction

evaluation.endpoint: Exact formula match and solver equivalence

studies.transfer_to_repo: Separate predicate identity from composition; clinical metric/name matching cannot safely use generic edit-distance equivalence.
source_locations: Official repository README, currently describing later GROVES data
studies.code_status: Repository inspected; current README/data description has evolved beyond paper snapshot

studies.title: Are LLMs Stable Formal Logic Translators in Logical Reasoning Across Linguistically Diversified Texts?
studies.representation: FOL with a maintained NL-concept/logical-symbol table
studies.method: SoLT meaning-preserving linguistic diversification; MenTaL reuses/refines symbol mappings and compound expressions.
studies.verification_guarantee: Benchmark checks outcomes and symbol drift; model manages semantic identity.
not_guaranteed: Low symbol dispersion does not rule out over-merging different concepts
Not all language rewrites have a formal source-fidelity proof
Benefits are model-dependent

evaluation.endpoint: Final accuracy and Symbol Dispersion Score
evaluation.caveat: SDS tracks one concept mapped to multiple symbols, not complete predicate/argument fidelity.

studies.transfer_to_repo: Test synonym consistency together with subtype and marker anti-merging; case 56 parent routing and case 773 metric mismatch need both.
source_locations: Original official URL https://github.com/wufeiwuwoshihua/LinguDiver redirects to the recorded code_url
studies.code_status: Repository redirect and README inspected; not executed

studies.title: Robustness of Neurosymbolic Reasoners on First-Order Logic Problems
studies.representation: FOL/Prover9 through LINC and NSCoT
studies.method: Counterfactual label-preserving problem rewrites; compare CoT, LINC, and CoT-before-formalization.
studies.verification_guarantee: Tests robustness of complete pipelines; no new source-equivalence guarantee.
not_guaranteed: A smaller counterfactual drop does not imply higher accuracy
Unknown predictions can change apparent robustness

evaluation.endpoint: Final accuracy and counterfactual performance gap

studies.transfer_to_repo: Require both absolute quality and perturbation stability; stable wrong/proxy answers must not count as faithful extraction.

studies.title: Discourse Representation Structures for ACE 6.7 / Attempto Parsing Engine
studies.primary_type: Author technical report and official language/parser documentation
studies.representation: Nested DRS with typed predicate arguments, implication/disjunction, classical negation, explicit modal extensions; FOL/PNF/TPTP exports for supported representations.
studies.method: A precisely controlled input language fixes coordination, quantifier scope and reference interpretation; parser compiles that language and exposes paraphrases and source sentence/token anchors.
studies.verification_guarantee: Unambiguous interpretation relative to ACE rules for accepted ACE text; deterministic compiler/export behavior is distinct from an LLM translation claim.
studies.not_guaranteed: Arbitrary guideline-to-ACE fidelity, intended clinical scope, author intent, corpus completeness. ACE 6.7 modal/negation-as-failure extensions must not all be mislabeled ordinary FOL.
studies.evaluation: Specification examples and executable parser interface, not a held-out arbitrary-guideline extraction accuracy benchmark.
studies.transfer_to_repo: Reference for audited controlled paraphrases, predicate/role/source anchors and distinguishing logical negation from failure-to-prove; adaptation requires independent source-to-paraphrase adjudication.

source_locations.supports: nested operators, distinct negations, source sentence/token numbers, cardinality scope

source_locations.location: Coordination; Scope of Subordinated Sentences; Quantifiers; Anaphora Resolution
source_locations.supports: fixed interpretation and ambiguity-restricting conventions
actual parser outputs and controlled paraphrase interface

studies.title: Minimal Recursion Semantics: An Introduction
studies.primary_type: Author-hosted research paper, supplemented by author research and official ERG documentation
studies.representation: Elementary predications plus handles, quantifier bound variables, restrictor/body and scope constraints; underspecified predicate calculus with generalized quantifiers, not merely an unordered triple set.
studies.method: Compositional grammar preserves semantic arguments while factoring out scope into explicit links; unresolved scope can denote multiple compatible readings.
studies.verification_guarantee: Representation preserves constraints under the specified compositional formalism; it permits reconstructing scope instead of erasing it.
studies.not_guaranteed: Correct selection of the intended reading from arbitrary clinical prose; fully resolved scope from syntax alone; reduction of all generalized quantifiers to ordinary FOL.
studies.evaluation: Formal representation/composition analysis and integration with broad-coverage HPSG; no reported universal clinical extraction score.
studies.transfer_to_repo: Strong counterexample to predicate-bag extraction; domains, roles and scope links must survive any flat storage. Preserving ambiguity is preferable to inventing a unique clinical scope.

source_locations.supports: scope-erased forms confound different universal statements; scope underspecification and restrictor/body
RMRS argument underspecification, algebra constraints and need for a grammar checker
ARG0/RSTR/BODY, syntactically partial scope, generalized quantifiers including most

studies.title: Wide-Coverage Semantic Analysis with Boxer
studies.representation: CCG-derived DRS, event variables and thematic roles, with FOL translation.
studies.method: Lexical semantics plus compositional derivation, followed by separate anaphora/presupposition resolution.
studies.verification_guarantee: Produces formally interpretable representations for accepted parses; it does not certify the parse or lexical interpretation.
studies.not_guaranteed: Source faithfulness, coreference, measurement interpretation or coordination scope; author explicitly reports failures.
studies.evaluation: >95% newswire coverage and complete DRSs for seven shared-task texts; authors explicitly lack gold representations to quantify semantic quality.
studies.transfer_to_repo: Useful component separation and event-role representation; coverage must not be reported as fidelity. Clinical causation/passive-role cases need their own validation.

source_locations.supports: composition, unresolved pronouns, role successes, measurement failures and unavailable gold accuracy
official PMB identifies Boxer as its CCG-to-DRS component; original historical C&C source URL was not revalidated as a live download

studies.title: The Parallel Meaning Bank: Towards a Multilingual Corpus of Translations Annotated with Compositional Meaning Representations
studies.primary_type: Primary corpus/system paper and official data documentation
studies.representation: Compositional DRS with layered tokenization, CCG syntax, semantic tags and normalized symbols.
studies.method: Automatic annotation plus persistent human corrections; conflicts with previously checked annotations are sent to expert re-adjudication.
studies.verification_guarantee: Explicit human-verification status and correction provenance; gold, silver and bronze do not denote the same evidence quality.
studies.not_guaranteed: Automatic DRS correctness; bilingual alignment always preserving meaning; generalization to multi-page clinical lists.
studies.evaluation: 2017 corpus construction/annotation counts. Official current data page lists v5.1.0 English gold=11,987 (2024-04-25), not an automatic extractor accuracy.
studies.transfer_to_repo: Source-first adjudicated rule units and reviewed-vs-machine-only status are supported by a mature semantic annotation workflow; operator/domain conflicts need targeted review.

source_locations.supports: compositional pipeline, NOT/POS tagging, persistent corrections and annotation-conflict review

source_locations.location: Data definition and Meaning Representations release table
source_locations.supports: human checked gold/partial silver/machine bronze and 5.1.0 counts
official pipeline components and links, not a single standalone source-to-FOL guarantee

studies.title: PICARD: Parsing Incrementally for Constrained Auto-Regressive Decoding from Language Models
studies.primary_type: Primary EMNLP paper and authors' code repository
studies.representation: SQL AST under lexical, grammar and table/alias scope guards.
studies.method: Incremental parser rejects inadmissible tokens during beam search; guards use declared database schema and symbol scope.
studies.verification_guarantee: Constraints implemented by parser/guards on successfully completed parses; output may still fail if beam search finds no valid completion.
studies.not_guaranteed: Correct query intent, source implication direction, all type checks, or faithful clinical interpretation. Paper leaves further type guards to future work.
studies.evaluation: T5-3B Spider development execution errors 12%→2%; exact-set match=75.5%, execution match=79.3%; these are separate endpoints.
studies.transfer_to_repo: Evidence for recursive syntax and binding guards. A syntactically valid excludes rule can still reverse the source; decoder constraints alone cannot adjudicate that.

source_locations.supports: lexing/parsing/scope guards, remaining checks, incomplete beam outcomes and distinct accuracy metrics

source_locations.location: How does PICARD work?; How well does PICARD work?
source_locations.supports: continuation parser behavior, original model links, exact/exec scores and execution error reduction

source_locations.location: ParserState; alias scope comments; GuardTableColumn, GuardAliasColumn, GuardColumn; withGuards
source_locations.supports: actual stored scope/alias environment and reference guards; current code inspection is not retroactively a 2021 feature claim

studies.title: Synchromesh: Reliable Code Generation from Pre-trained Language Models
studies.primary_type: Primary ICLR paper and Microsoft Research publication page
studies.code_status: No author-maintained implementation link established from the primary paper/publication page; the retrieved kanishkg/synchromesh repository explicitly labels itself unofficial and was not used as primary implementation evidence.
studies.representation: SQL, Vega-Lite and SMCalFlow programs with completion engines enforcing syntax, scope, types and context-specific constraints.
studies.method: Constrained Semantic Decoding plus examples retrieved by target AST similarity (TST). Guarantees are relative to implemented completion-engine constraints.
studies.verification_guarantee: Completed generated programs satisfy the CE constraints under the stated CE axioms/decoding assumptions.
studies.not_guaranteed: Conceptual fidelity to natural-language intent; §4.2 explicitly supplies a valid-but-wrong visualization counterexample. Original domains are not Turing-complete Python.
studies.evaluation: Table2 Codex175B SQL CSD+TST: validity85%, execution match64%; SMCalFlow validity99%, exact match63%. Validity is not intent correctness.
studies.transfer_to_repo: Typed/domain-aware completion and examples selected by logical form are relevant; neither certifies which connective or implication the guideline intended.

source_locations.supports: AST example similarity, constraint guarantee, measured validity/accuracy split, explicit conceptual-error and language-scope limits
author/team provenance, target languages and public paper link

studies.title: Type-Constrained Code Generation with Language Models
studies.primary_type: Primary PLDI paper and authors' reproduction package
studies.representation: Simply typed language LB and TypeScript implementation using prefix automata and a type environment.
studies.method: Type search checks whether a partial expression can still be completed to an expression of the required type, beyond grammar-only masking.
studies.verification_guarantee: Sound well-typed completion for the covered language subset and completed generation; the formal construction intentionally sacrifices completeness for type-search termination.
studies.not_guaranteed: All TypeScript features, higher-order type completeness, functional correctness or correspondence to natural-language specifications. Prefix completable does not guarantee that the LLM terminates or stays within token/time budgets; §6 reports loops/truncations among remaining compiler errors.
studies.evaluation: TypeScript HumanEval/MBPP synthesis, translation and repair; paper reports compilation errors reduced by more than half and relative functional-correctness gains3.5%–5.5% for synthesis/translation.
studies.transfer_to_repo: Domain/role/quantity typing can rule out impossible bindings but not a well-typed donor/recipient swap or valid-yet-reversed logical rule.

source_locations.supports: syntax-vs-type distinction, prefix completion, intentionally incomplete covered subset and empirical endpoints; distinction between prefix-completion guarantee and actual generation termination
actual parser interface, incomplete-prefix examples and reproduction package

studies.title: Combinatorial Sketching for Finite Programs
studies.primary_type: Primary ASPLOS research paper and author code repository
studies.representation: Finite programs with holes plus a separate formal executable specification; synthesis problem uses bounded input semantics.
studies.method: Two SAT solvers alternate synthesis and verification; a violating input becomes a new synthesis constraint until the formal specification is met.
studies.verification_guarantee: Correctness relative to the supplied formal specification and finite domain; theoretical completion for a realizable sketch within the finite setup.
studies.not_guaranteed: That the formal specification faithfully captures an English guideline; unbounded/general-purpose correctness or practical termination within any fixed budget.
studies.evaluation: Finite programming kernels including AES; not text-to-FOL extraction or clinical diagnosis.
studies.transfer_to_repo: Counterexamples can discriminate candidate formula/executor variants only when an independently grounded reference behavior or specification exists; a self-generated specification can certify its own mistake.

source_locations.supports: formal-specification boundary, synthesize-verify counterexamples and bounded-domain guarantee

source_locations.location: Repository docs/SketchManual, benchmarks, source and README
source_locations.supports: author-associated implementation availability; no claim of reproducing it in this audit

studies.title: LogicNG: Normal Form Transformations
studies.representation: Propositional formula trees, NNF/CNF/DNF, auxiliary-variable encodings.
studies.method: Separate equivalent factorization from Tseitin/Plaisted-Greenbaum equisatisfiable transforms; preserve subformula definitions for SAT-oriented compilation.
studies.verification_guarantee: Truth-equivalent transformation or equisatisfiability as specified by the selected algorithm, assuming the input formula is correct. For full definitional Tseitin encoding with an asserted root, phi(x) iff exists z T(x,z), preserving models projected onto original variables; this is stronger than equisatisfiability alone.
studies.not_guaranteed: Source-to-formula fidelity; equisatisfiability alone is not pointwise equivalence over all original and auxiliary variable assignments.
studies.evaluation: Algorithm specification and worked examples; no extraction performance experiment.
studies.transfer_to_repo: CNF/DNF need not be the extraction surface form. Retain source AST/graph; canonicalization can be a downstream operation, with auxiliary-variable semantics explicit.

source_locations.location: CNF Transformations; CNF Factorization; Tseitin Transformation; Plaisted-Greenbaum Transformation
source_locations.supports: exponential expansion risk, auxiliary variables, equivalence versus equisatisfiability
official author textbook explanation of exponential equivalent CNF versus equisatisfiable encoding; auxiliary definitions, extending assignments and projecting models

studies.title: CPGPrompt: Translating Clinical Guidelines into LLM-Executable Decision Support
studies.primary_type: primary preprint; journal publication independently identified
studies.representation: JSON threshold decision tree: name, yes_action, no_node, criteria:[str], min_criteria:int.
studies.method: Manual passage selection; LLM local subtrees; merge; every tree manually validated, with regeneration and manual adjustment; LLM leaf queries.
studies.verification_guarantee: Program applies min_criteria before a group action; no source-equivalence theorem.
studies.not_guaranteed: No automated extraction fidelity rate; no recursive criterion AST; binary response parser lacks unknown; free-text leaf semantics remain LLM-dependent.
studies.evaluation: Synthetic referral/pathway evaluation. Table 2 headache binary F1 .90 and fine-grained macro F1 .44; low-back-pain set has 99/99 referral-positive cases. Vignettes were generated from validated trees; three clinicians checked 10 cases per domain, so the execution test is not an independent check of source omissions shared with those trees.
studies.transfer_to_repo: 522: group threshold distinct from leaf support. 74/49: path and patient-query correctness remain separate. Do not copy name identity or sequential no-branch merge.

studies.title: Text2MDT: Extracting Medical Decision Trees from Medical Texts
studies.representation: Binary decision tree; node Role, Triplets, Logical_Rel (AND/OR/NULL); preorder serialization.
studies.method: Expert-involved Chinese annotation; triples → node grouping → assembly, compared with instruction-tuned end-to-end models and CoT variants.
studies.verification_guarantee: Human-reference exact whole-tree accuracy and decision-path F1; these measure agreement within the supported representation.
studies.not_guaranteed: Authors explicitly limit node logical combinations, multi-stage action continuation, and cross-paragraph knowledge. No general quantified FOL or zero-error guarantee.
studies.evaluation: Table 4: Baichuan2-7B CoT-Generation-3 TreeAcc .490, DP-F1 .632; pipeline .470/.631. Table 3 assembly-subtask .748 is not end-to-end fidelity. Test set n=100; reported scores average five runs, not one run with exactly 49/100 correct.
studies.transfer_to_repo: 522: separate atom/group/tree scores and preserve logical_rel. 56: condition and action roles cannot collapse into one disease relation. Multi-depth structure remains harder.

source_locations.code_access: Paper-linked repo and API main/master returned unavailable/404 on access date; code not inspected.

studies.title: MedDM: LLM-executable clinical guidance tree for clinical decision-making
studies.representation: Natural-language clinical guidance tree, root/condition/action nodes; hierarchical If/Elif/Else text (IEET).
studies.method: Flowchart shape/OCR/edge recognition, manual calibration and repair, then CGT conversion and further manual validation.
studies.verification_guarantee: Explicit Yes/No/Unable-to-determine interaction and inspectable flowchart paths; manual quality process, not formal equivalence proof.
studies.not_guaranteed: Already-structured source diagrams; no automatic source-fidelity rate or population-level diagnostic performance shown. Unknown fallback may ask LLM over subtree.
studies.evaluation: 1202 curated trees: 443 differential diagnosis, 759 treatment. Two-pass flowchart calibration by 8 graduate students; later transformation validation by 7.
studies.transfer_to_repo: 74/522: unknown must remain a state. Source diagram arrows aid direction; natural-language node interpretation still needs clinical audit. Cyclic workflow conversion can change semantics.

source_locations.code_access: No official implementation link located in paper or targeted title/GitHub searches.

studies.title: Automatic Conversion of NICE Guidelines to an Executable Computational Model Using Large Language Models
studies.primary_type: primary journal paper, Learning Health Systems e70114
studies.representation: ASP constants, predicates, rules; Clingo executes patient facts plus normative rules; cardinality/choice constructs.
studies.method: D2K: constants → predicates → rules with six shared examples. K2P: LLM patient fact extraction. Three clinician reviewers compare source, ASP, controlled-language rendering.
studies.verification_guarantee: Executable stable-model semantics conditional on supplied rules/facts; source fidelity assessed empirically, not proven.
studies.not_guaranteed: Temporal procedure omissions, arity/qualifier loss, extraneous/missing patient facts, negation-as-failure on incomplete records. Hallucination definition broader than this repo audit.
studies.evaluation: 20 pancreatic vignettes: mean recommendation F1 .825±.127; activate about64% of rules. Public reviewer CSV denominators and values differ from paper figure; separate recomputation below.
studies.transfer_to_repo: 49/74: procedural order is not simple negation. 56/773: patient binding separated from guideline translation. Fixed source units needed before interpreting faithful/omitted percentages.

reviewer_csv_recomputation.definition: Mean of each of three reviewers category count / their CSV row count; categories 0 no-rule,1 correct,2 incorrect,3 missing-key-information,4 hallucination. These are row-rating percentages, not fixed-source faithful recall.

studies.title: From Guidelines to Code: Formalizing STOPP/START Criteria Using LLMs and RAG for Clinical Decision Support
studies.representation: Python using expert-built Speak-PIM classes, condition presence/absence and STOPP/START actions; standardized ICD-10/LOINC/ATC entities.
studies.method: GPT-4o-mini extracts entities and maps retrieved codes; DeepSeek generates code with a one-shot example and framework constraints.
studies.verification_guarantee: Preliminary manual checks of entity extraction, mappings, class signatures and rule logic; no theorem or complete executable test suite reported.
studies.not_guaranteed: Only10 difficulty-selected rules; small observation count; manual framework took months; reproducibility concerns. Medication advice is not diagnosis confirmation.
studies.evaluation: Five STOPP/five START; reported entity extraction and framework logic correct; mapping F1 disease .92, medication .90, observation1.00.
studies.transfer_to_repo: 56/91: ontology mapping must retain assay/concept identity. 522/773: performed test and result are different types. START/STOP action direction is distinct from diagnostic exclusion.

source_locations.code_access: No public pipeline implementation found in paper or targeted title/Speak-PIM searches.

studies.title: CliCARE: Grounding Large Language Models in Clinical Guidelines for Decision Support over Longitudinal Cancer Electronic Health Records
studies.representation: Patient temporal event KG separate from normative guideline KG; path alignment and LLM recommendation generation.
studies.method: Timestamped event extraction/ontology linkage; guideline summarization→structured JSON→Neo4j; sum-of-max similarity path ranking, LLM rerank and expansion.
studies.verification_guarantee: Temporal and workflow representations are inspectable; no logical entailment or automated source-fidelity guarantee.
studies.not_guaranteed: KG edge presence is not AND/OR evaluation. Matching formula does not enforce distinct witnesses or order; source summarization remains lossy. Clinical output judge scores are not extractor precision.
studies.evaluation: CancerEHR and MIMIC-Cancer summary/recommendation evaluation using a clinician-validated LLM judge; source-rule exact fidelity not reported.
studies.transfer_to_repo: 49/74: event timestamps and normative/descriptive separation useful. 522/773: do not inherit sum-max counting or treat stage/biomarker strings as typed predicates.

studies.title: MedGuideX: Internalizing Decision Logic from Executable Guidelines into Large Language Models for Clinical Reasoning
studies.representation: Finite Boolean decision trees compiled to Python f(X); executable factual/counterfactual supervision for SFT/RL.
studies.method: Extract actionable recommendations; LLM tree validation; compile and test syntax/executability/tree consistency; execute functions for labels and rewards.
studies.verification_guarantee: Labels consistent with accepted executable function on evaluated inputs; no guarantee function or variable schema matches source semantics.
studies.not_guaranteed: No independently adjudicated source-level fidelity rate found. Complete Boolean assignments hide clinical unknowns. Counterfactual filtering discards unchanged outputs.
studies.evaluation: Appendix C:3796 retained recommendations→2800 LLM-validated trees→2793 executable functions. These are filtering yields, not extraction accuracy. Physician preference study evaluates30 already-correct diagnostic cases.
studies.transfer_to_repo: 74/522: program-derived paired tests are promising; retain invariant as well as changing examples. 49/56/773: ensure source/binding oracle before self-consistent program supervision.

source_locations.code_access: No official implementation link found in full text or targeted title/author searches.

studies.title: Decision Tree Extraction for Clinical Decision Support System With If-Else Pseudocode and PlanSelect Strategy
studies.primary_type: primary journal abstract plus official implementation
studies.representation: If/elif/else pseudocode skeleton filled with extracted triples; node role C/D and logical_rel and/or/null.
studies.method: Pseudocode structure followed by constrained triplet selection and node logic; inspectable intermediate files and tree/path equality evaluator.
studies.verification_guarantee: Official evaluator includes role, logical_rel and triples in tree/path equality; no source-equivalence guarantee.
studies.not_guaranteed: Full publisher PDF could not be fetched; do not cite unverified comparative numerical gains. Code permits condition deletion when no triple found and compresses descendants; single node logic remains and/or.
studies.evaluation: Official abstract reports Text2DT/EMDT and downstream CMBClin/MedQA. Local read confirms metrics implementation, not the reported score reproducibility.
studies.transfer_to_repo: 522: separate skeleton, leaf alignment and logic; 56/74: node-fill failure must not silently promote a decision into a broader scope. Relation type determines C/D, so relation errors remain causal.
